title: GMO-E$^2$DIT: Grounded Multi-Operation Editing for E-Commerce Images
abstract: Real-world e-commerce image editing often requires multiple, localized, and auditable operations rather than global restyling. This compositional nature poses a dual challenge: models must precisely apply all requested edits to the correct regions while preserving unmodified content, even under ambiguous instructions. Existing one-shot editors conflate intent resolution, spatial grounding, and synthesis into a single step, frequently resulting in partial execution failures, which is unacceptable for commercial scenarios. To address this, we introduce GMO-E$^2$DIT, an agentic editing framework that couples a Vision-Language Model (VLM) with a mask-conditioned image editor to tackle structured multi-turn task completion. Given an underspecified instruction, the VLM agent constructs a region-grounded edit agenda, effectively decoupling cognitive reasoning from generative rendering. The framework then executes sub-programs via operation-aware masks and references, utilizing a reflection-driven loop to inspect intermediate results and determine the subsequent state. This iterative mechanism reliably preserves safe partial progress, retries unfinished operations, and recovers from errors. Furthermore, we develop a unified data pipeline providing aligned supervision for planning, execution, and reflection, alongside EComEditBench, a comprehensive benchmark for instruction-driven evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GMO-E$^2$DIT achieves competitive performance compared to strong closed-source models, yielding superior instruction accuracy and edit fidelity over existing baselines.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2607.00920v3 的 23 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：not-found。
analysis.ideaZh: GMO-E2DIT 把局部图像编辑编译为typed agenda：operation、source/target boxes、attributes及patch references，再用mask-conditioned editor执行。VLM反思分别选择success、continue或rollback，保留安全partial progress；SFT/GRPO训练planner与diagnosis，最后冻结editor做agent-loop RL。作者报告1000例EComEditBench fuzzy IA/EF/BP为8.66/8.25/8.87；7-10操作集reflection相对fixed-turn的IA仅7.29对7.21。适合借鉴结构化edit programs和rollback，但主要证据来自合成电商海报及单VLM评分，无通用设计迁移实证。
analysis.motivationZh: 电商图像包含多个需准确局部操作的标签/产品；模糊指令下one-shot会漏做、混淆source/target或损坏已完成修改。
analysis.methodZh: Qwen3.5-9B agent与Flux2-Klein-9B editor分离reasoning/rendering。数据从YOLO/SAM/OCR拆poster assets并恢复background，HTML作replacement中间结构，再合成aligned plan/edit/reflection samples。训练16B200，agent LoRA SFT与rule GRPO、editor LoRA、冻结editor的multi-round agent RL。精确协议给region annotations，fuzzy协议要求自行ground。
methodFlow: 安全继续或回退last-safe image并重新规划
analysis.experimentsZh: 1000 EComEditBench，500单操作/500多操作，训练test在product/edit-program层disjoint；Gemini3Pro固定judge，另1000fuzzy cases human head-to-head；7-10操作集验证multi-turn。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告完整Stage1-3 fuzzy整体8.664/8.247/8.871，SFT agent为8.528/8.079/8.768。（Table2, PDF p.9）；作者报告reflection7.29/6.47/8.42，相同Stage3 fixed-turn7.21/6.37/8.08。（Table3, PDF p.9） 对照范围：NanoBanana2/Pro、Seedream5、Wan2.7ImagePro及Qwen/Flux/FireRed；新增domain LoRA训练和agent算力不与所有baseline匹配，主评分依赖Gemini。 消融与诊断：editor domain SFT带来大提升；agent SFT/GRPO/joint-loop incremental比较与one-turn/fixed-turn/reflection；未报告跨一般图像域或SVG操作迁移。
analysis.insightZh: 实质贡献为program-level state diagnosis与operation-role compiler，加上对planning/execution/reflection的统一数据和分阶段训练；editor在joint RL中冻结，不能说两模型同时RL更新。
analysis.evidenceZh: typed agenda与compiler把region roles转换为masks/references。（Sec.3.1-3.2, Fig.2, PDF pp.3-4）；continue保留正确progress，rollback丢弃corrupt candidate；Stage3仅更新agent、editor frozen。（Sec.3.2-3.3, PDF pp.4-5）；作者报告fuzzy平均IA8.66/EF8.25/BP8.87；precise9.82/9.62/9.85。（Table1, PDF p.8）；作者报告reflection比fixed-turn IA7.29对7.21、BP8.42对8.08。（Table3, PDF p.9; Appendix E.1, PDF p.20）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: typed edit agenda、safe-progress与rollback可迁移到结构化视觉工具控制；实证限于电商raster editing。
analysis.caveatZh: VLM错误grounding或reflection可破坏全部流程。；数据以synthetic/semi-synthetic e-commerce posters为主。；多轮VLM/editor增加latency，实时使用受限。；单judge打分不是确定性region-preservation保证；精确协议给boxes且转换masks，本方法有专门训练优势。；未找到本文打印的公开Code URL，复现门槛包括训练数据和16B200配置。
